name: meshix
description: Create, route, and review Meshix CAD designs from Codex.

interface.longDescription: Create and inspect CAD designs with Meshix. Find owned designs, published gallery designs, and Community History. Prepare a dimensioned request, generate or revise CAD, review progress, and inspect 3D previews, CAD renders, STL and STEP outputs. Sign in to Meshix to connect your account. Generation is asynchronous; generated artifacts do not guarantee physical fit or manufacturing safety. Assembly is a beta feature requiring explicit opt-in.
defaultPrompt: Open the public Meshix bridge riser design.
